capabilities: Create column layouts with col and col-md callouts
Build columns with col and col-md codeblocks and a settings block
Set column height, text alignment, flex-grow widths, and borders
Create columns using a nested list structure
Wrap narrow columns into rows on mobile via a minimum width setting
extras: README lists upcoming features (editor syntax highlighting) and ends with a request for donations; no screenshots included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to arrange note content into multiple columns side by side.
summary: Multi-column layout plugin that renders column groups in notes using callout, codeblock, or list syntax with width, height, and border settings.
